title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Operations Standard: Placing, Dispensing and Shipping Orders
content:
## Operations standard: orders against prescriptions on file

**Standard.** An order is placed only against a prescription on file at the Home Delivery Pharmacy that has not passed its expiration date (the program's prescription validity in months after the written date, or the Schedule II validity in calendar days for a Schedule II drug) and has a fill remaining (the fill's sequence number not above the refills authorized). An order can be placed only for a prescription already on file for this account. A refill ships only once the program's elapsed share of the previous shipped fill's days supply has elapsed, counted in calendar days from the ship date of the latest shipped fill of the same prescription, and each fill is between the program's fewest days supply per fill (except a first fill or a dose titration) and the program's most days supply per fill. A prescription has at most one open order: a new order may be placed only when no placed order for the same prescription is still unshipped and uncancelled. An order ships only while the account is active; while it is on hold, placed orders wait, and an order still held the program's hold-cancellation days after the hold date is cancelled with the reason hold expired. New prescriptions dispense within the program's new-prescription processing business days and refills within the program's refill processing business days, then travel the program's standard shipping transit days unless expedited. Controlled substances are dispensed only where the program dispenses them by mail and with adult signature where the program requires it.

### Pre-order checks, all read from system records

| Check | Passes when | Record read |
|---|---|---|
| Prescription on file | the prescription is on file for this account | prescriptions on file for the account |
| Not expired | the order falls on or before the prescription's last fillable date | the prescription's expiration date |
| Fill remaining | the fill's sequence number is not above the refills authorized | the prescription's refills authorized |
| One open order | no placed order for the same prescription is still unshipped and uncancelled | the order events of that prescription |

### Shipping depends on the account status

| Account status | What happens to a placed order |
|---|---|
| Active | it may ship |
| On hold | it waits; if still held the program's hold-cancellation days after the hold date (hold date is day zero), it is cancelled with the reason hold expired |

### Refill timing, worked (hypothetical fill)

A previous shipped fill carried 90 days supply and the program's elapsed share is 0.75. The refill may ship once 67.5 days have elapsed: on the 67th calendar day after the ship date it may not, on the 68th it may.

### Questions answered

- *Can a second order be placed for a prescription whose earlier order is still being processed?* No; the earlier placed order is still unshipped and uncancelled.
- *Can a fill shorter than the fewest days supply be dispensed for a maintenance drug?* Only for a first fill or a dose titration.
